messages:
Maria: hey folks — quick idea: Friday 5pm rooftop picnic + low-key open mic (acoustic, poetry, jokes). BYO blanket/plate. thinking snacks + small bento-style share so veg options pls. ☀️🎤
Calendar-bot: Event created: 'Rooftop Quiet Open Mic Picnic' — Fri 5pm — RSVP in thread — reminders set.
Jamal: love this. count me in. can bring acoustic guitar :guitar: 
Priya: in! i can do miso eggplant bento (vegan) — do we need plates/cutlery?
Owen: I'll bring a big blanket and a portable speaker (low volume promise). also can grab compostable plates.
Claire: can we slot 5-7 so late folks can join?
Maria: yep 5-7 works. aim's mellow — no amplified drums lol.
Priya: any allergies? my sesame marinade has peanuts? (actually sesame but no peanuts)
Jamal: i'm allergic to shellfish — marking in the RSVP.
Maria: updated note: no shellfish pls.
Owen: weather check — forecast shows light drizzle. backup plan: lobby mezzanine.
Priya: mezzanine ok for me.
Claire: can someone make a simple sign-up list for who brings what? maybe a Google Sheet?
Maria: created sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rwfd-open-mic-picnic (roles + song slots). add your name under items.
Jamal: added guitar, mic stand, chord book
Priya: added miso eggplant, 2 portions
Claire: i'll bring 6 compostable plates + napkins
Owen: marked speaker + blanket
Maya: :raised_hands: can't do food but i'll handle setup/buzzer and MC for 20 mins
Maria: amazing — last Q: anyone wants to perform? add a 2-min slot in sheet or chime here.
Priya: i'll do a short poem.
Jamal: two songs from me.
Claire: i'll be the backup playlist if tech fails.
Maria: perfect. see you Friday! feel free to ping me with transport needs or accessible seating. :party-parrot: 
Calendar-bot: Reminder set: 1 day before + 1 hour before.
